name: std::flat_map<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::value_comp
intro: Returns a function object that compares objects of type std::flat_map::value_type (key-value pairs) by using key_comp to compare the first components of the pairs.

examples.output:
(1,a) goes before key (100)
(2,b) goes before key (100)
(3,c) equivalent to key (100)
(4,d) goes after key (100)
(5,e) goes after key (100)
